description:
Lee Sol, a second-year student at Onjeong High School, is a boy with a warm appearance and a moderately flashy personality. On a field trip to an art museum, Lee Sol meets Song I-do, a girl in the class next to him.

Love at first sight.

Lee Sol, who found dating the easiest, did as usual.

He answers that he will accept Lee Sol’s confession.

Will Lee Sol be able to make a proper confession after a week? A full-fledged 'language' romantic comedy about Lee Sol, who even thinks in 'memes', and Song Ido, who has trouble speaking in an orderly manner!
